title: WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce
abstract: arXiv:2611.30662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models that deliver frontier e-commerce capabilities while achieving state-of-the-art general-purpose performance at their respective scales. The family spans five sizes, from a 0.8B dense model to a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters. Our training pipeline begins with two-stage continued pre-training that progressively raises the proportion of e-commerce data within a diverse multimodal data mixture, followed by hybrid-thinking post-training that combines on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning to support both non-thinking and thinking modes. For evaluation, we construct a comprehensive suite of 28 e-commerce benchmarks (23 in-house and five open-source) covering eight business scenarios and complement it with 64 public general-purpose benchmarks. On the e-commerce suite, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B surpasses substantially larger open-source flagship models,

translated_title: WeMM-Ecom：推进微信电商的多模态内容理解
translated_abstract: 我们提出WeMM-Ecom，这是一系列多模态大语言模型，在提供前沿电商能力的同时，在其各自规模上实现了最先进的通用性能。该系列涵盖五种规模，从0.8B的稠密模型到拥有3B激活参数的35B混合专家模型。我们的训练流程始于两阶段持续预训练，在多样化的多模态数据混合中逐步提高电商数据的比例，随后进行混合思考后训练，结合在线策略蒸馏和强化学习，以同时支持非思考模式和思考模式。在评估方面，我们构建了一套包含28个电商基准的全面评估套件（23个自建、5个开源），覆盖八个业务场景，并辅以64个公开的通用基准。在电商评估套件上，WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B显著超越了大得多的开源旗舰模型。
tldr: WeMM-Ecom是一系列面向微信电商的多模态大语言模型，通过两阶段电商数据持续预训练和结合在线策略蒸馏与强化学习的混合思考后训练，在覆盖八类业务场景的电商基准上超越更大规模的开源旗舰模型，同时保持同规模领先的通用性能。
